obsidiceratops.texte: The Obsidiceratops is a superheated tank with a large appetite for lava. It roams the Redstone Caves, where lava runs close to the surface.
The Obsidiceratops is a strong mount, able to carry both lava and items through the depths.

chorusoatl.texte: The Chorusoatl is a graceful flier that drifts in groups through the prismarine chasms. When threatened, the flock fights back with a powerful screech and overwhelming attacks.
The egg hatches in complete darkness, resting on Prismoss with Prismoss sprouts or prismarine crystals nearby. Once hatched, you can feed it Chorus Fruit to speed up growth.
The Chorusoatl can be saddled, which lets you glide freely over the chasms.
The Chorus Scythe can be crafted with Chorus Fossils, which Archie sells once you have tamed a Chorusoatl.
